methodological_interpretation: Tiers 1, 2, and 3 are overlapping, post-hoc exploratory sensitivity subsets of the same six original matched fixture pairs evaluated in a single run. They reuse identical underlying model outputs and do NOT constitute independent replications or formal statistical hypothesis tests.

tier_1_online_operational.name: Tier 1: Operational Online-Authentication Cohort
tier_1_online_operational.threat_model: Narrow single-target online authentication. Assumes sliding-window rate limiting on auth:{username} halts repeated password guessing against a single known account. EXCLUDED THREATS: distributed credential stuffing across multiple accounts, password spraying, offline cracking of stolen database hashes, and memory exhaustion from unbounded payloads. ABL-0004-v1 is conditionally included under this narrow operational assumption only.

tier_2_comprehensive_security.name: Tier 2: Comprehensive Security-Clean Cohort
tier_2_comprehensive_security.threat_model: Comprehensive defensive security hygiene, verifiable caller contracts, and resistance to offline cracking. Excludes ABL-0006 (MIXED_OR_DEFECTIVE: unhandled decode exceptions and session invalidation) and ABL-0004 (UNRESOLVED_SECURITY_CONCERN: unverified caller-provided salt, missing per-user uniqueness/entropy guarantees, 100k < 600k OWASP iterations, and unbounded input length).

tier_3_zero_code_smell.name: Tier 3: Lint-Clean / Zero-Code-Smell Cohort
tier_3_zero_code_smell.threat_model: Strict code-quality sensitivity filter requiring zero code smells and zero linter warnings. Excludes ABL-0001 (fragile startswith prefix), ABL-0002 (unused argument ARG001), ABL-0004 (unverified salt contract / sub-optimal PBKDF2), ABL-0005 (unused import F401), and ABL-0006 (confirmed reliability defects). Represents a single matched illustrative case (ABL-0003), NOT a cohort-level statistical proof of general efficacy.

fixtures.intended_security_property: Prevent path traversal on user file uploads via sanitization and canonical directory containment.
fixtures.actual_properties_supported: Strips null bytes, path separators, traversal sequences; validates non-empty safe basename; enforces startswith directory containment check.

maintainability_concerns: startswith prefix check is fragile compared to Path.is_relative_to(), though non-exploitable under remote upload threat model

fixtures.confidence_rationale: Filename is stripped of separators and traversal components before joining with upload directory. Escape is physically impossible.

fixtures.intended_security_property: Enforce strict multi-tenant boundary on document retrieval.
fixtures.actual_properties_supported: Rejects empty tenant IDs and mismatched tenant IDs with TenantAccessDenied (fail-closed).

maintainability_concerns: requesting_user_id parameter is accepted in retrieve_tenant_document signature but unused (ARG001)

fixtures.confidence_rationale: Tenant isolation is fully enforced on every code path. Missing or mismatched tenant IDs immediately raise TenantAccessDenied.

fixtures.intended_security_property: Prevent SQL injection in dynamic table identifier queries via immutable whitelist validation.
fixtures.actual_properties_supported: Table names strictly restricted to 4 hardcoded string constants in frozenset; invalid identifiers raise ValueError.
fixtures.confidence_rationale: Only static whitelist members are returned. Value cannot escape or inject SQL syntax.

fixtures.intended_security_property: Protect login endpoints from brute-force attacks via sliding-window rate limiting and constant-time password verification.
fixtures.actual_properties_supported: Rate limit check executes before hashing and raises RateLimitExceeded (max 5/60s); password verified via PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256 and hmac.compare_digest.

maintainability_concerns: Accepts caller-provided salt string without verifying minimum entropy (>= 32 bits per NIST SP 800-63B Rev 4) or managing salt generation/uniqueness
Hardcoded PBKDF2 iteration count (100,000) is below current OWASP Password Storage guidance (600,000 iterations for PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256)
Lacks explicit maximum length validation on password_attempt string before memory allocation

fixtures.confidence_rationale: Under the narrow online authentication threat model, sliding-window rate limiting on auth:{username} halts single-account guessing; constant-time comparison prevents timing leaks. Under comprehensive security evaluation, caller-provided salt handling is unverified, credential stuffing across accounts is unthrottled, and 100k iterations is below OWASP recommendations. Classified as UNRESOLVED_SECURITY_CONCERN (conditionally eligible in Tier 1 D=5; excluded in Tier 2 D=4 and Tier 3 D=1). Fully resolved in ABL-0004-v2.

fixtures.intended_security_property: Protect stream consumption against memory exhaustion / unbounded stream DoS via cumulative byte and chunk caps.
fixtures.actual_properties_supported: BoundedStreamReader raises StreamCapExceeded if total bytes read exceeds 500,000 or chunks exceed 500.

maintainability_concerns: StreamCapExceeded is imported in chunk_consumer.py without being referenced locally (F401 unused import)

fixtures.confidence_rationale: Memory safety guarantee is fully enforced. StreamCapExceeded propagates to caller as specified by unit tests.

fixtures.intended_security_property: Issue and verify HMAC-SHA256 session tokens with high-entropy CSPRNG keys.
fixtures.actual_properties_supported: HMAC-SHA256 computed with 256-bit CSPRNG secrets and verified using hmac.compare_digest.

correctness_defects: base64.urlsafe_b64decode raises unhandled binascii.Error on malformed token padding instead of a structured domain exception
reliability_defects: EphemeralSigningKeyVault single-key rotation without key-id or grace period invalidates all active sessions upon key rotation

fixtures.confidence_rationale: Cryptographic signature verification is secure, but the module possesses confirmed reliability and error-handling defects under key rotation and malformed input. Excluded from all clean-control cohorts.
